climate.source: Wikipedia Jammu climate table, citing IMD; primary source not yet independently retrieved
climate.station: Jammu, WMO 42056 (station ID from cited reference)
climate.primaryStatus: HTTP 503 when checked; secondary-source transcription only
climate.note: Uses the explicitly dated climate table, not contradictory undated prose on the same page. Monthly averages are not extremes, forecasts or a site microclimate.

references.title: Jammu: the yearly climate
references.finding: 1991–2020 table reports June mean daily high 38.3°C, January mean daily low 7.3°C, and July rain 416.5 mm. Primary IMD PDF retrieval failed; this distinction is explicit.

references.title: IMD climate services
references.finding: Official climate-service index was accessible. It links climate information and IMD Pune services. Its current-weather pages do not substitute for yearly normals.

references.title: Modern living-room references
references.finding: Listing includes Tenang House, Eklavya House and Indian residential interiors. Use for furniture scale, storage and palette comparisons; no claim that their climate or layout matches your site.

references.title: Indian interior projects
references.finding: India interior category index is accessible; project results need separate review. It is a discovery source, not evidence for dimensions, construction details or a Jammu-specific thermal design.

references.title: YouTube: compact Indian homes
references.finding: Video access returned a proxy 403. This is a suggested search, not an endorsed or watched video. Review dimensions, ventilation, concealed storage and real construction costs once access is enabled.

references.title: Colour and thermal comfort
references.finding: Light interiors support brightness. Exterior solar reflectance, insulation, shading, ventilation and humidity control determine thermal performance; paint colour alone is not a cooling system.

references.title: Safe cot placement for your babies
references.finding: Room sharing uses a separate infant sleep space near the parents. Use a firm, flat, level surface with a fitted sheet and no loose bedding, pillows or cot bumpers. The 3D cots are layout placeholders, not fabrication specifications.

solarGeometry.source: Jammu latitude from retrieved Wikipedia page; spherical solar-geometry calculation
solarGeometry.model: Level horizon, solar centre at zero elevation; ignores refraction, terrain and buildings
solarGeometry.interpretation: Approximate summer sunset aligns with the NW rear; winter sunrise is near the SE front. This supports adjustable shading rather than permanently closing rear glazing. Actual obstruction survey is required.
